title: The Sales Representative list looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "card-04-n1-list.png" (board 1.4) and "card-15-n1-unassign-list.png" (board 1.15) attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its one "Sales Representative" field reads "Unassigned".
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in that browser window.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the field and compare the open list with the picture of board 1.4.
  2. Pick {Sales-rep-A}, open the list again and compare with the picture of board 1.15.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the list opens under the field; "Unassigned" is first and checked, then the representatives; no search box; as in the picture.
  • Step 2: {Sales-rep-A} is the checked option and "Unassigned" is still first, as in the picture.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S1-R8, S1-R9, S1-R12, read 19 Oct 2026. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R8: “Clicking the field opens a dropdown. Its first option is "Unassigned", followed by every active sales representative, sorted by first name, then last name, A to Z.”
  • S1-R9: “The option for the person in the field is checked. With nobody assigned, "Unassigned" is checked.”
  • S1-R12: “The dropdown has no search box.”

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 1.4 The list: Unassigned first; 1.15 Clearing: pick Unassigned (the attached pictures are these boards).

Design pictures attached to this case: card-04-n1-list.png, card-15-n1-unassign-list.png.

  • Design — board 1.4 title: “1.4 The list: Unassigned first”
  • Design — board 1.4 note: “"Unassigned" is the first option, checked when nobody is picked, then every active sales representative.”
  • Design — board 1.15 title: “1.15 Clearing: pick Unassigned”
  • Design — board 1.15 note: “To clear the field, open its list and pick "Unassigned", the first option (decision 69). Daniel Montoya is checked as the current rep.”
